culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Mitomu Kushiyama. First, he called a test number to make it seems that he received a call from someone. When he left the seat, he tipped over the strawberry on Hanasaki's cake while he was not looking. Hanasaki then noticed the strawberry and would have complained. However, he couldn't do that because he had issued an apology for striking a customer with the fork while complaining in the past. This forced Hanasaki to swap his cake with Kushiyama's cake, which had been poisoned.
